output.rationale: The requirement specifies metal-clad switchgear with specific features such as independent trip coils and compatibility with other breakers of the same rating. Among the candidates, 'CROWN-ARMV' from the CROWN business unit is an engineered-to-order (ETO) product that provides metal-clad medium-voltage switchgear with vacuum circuit breakers, which aligns with the requirement. Other candidates either do not match the specification or are not related to switchgear.
